newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures close narrowly mixed.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures close narrowly mixed.

text.p: July 8 - U.S. debt futures closed narrowly mixed. U.S. Redbook retail sales index rose 1.7 pct in fiscal June vs last month, as expected. Sept T-bonds ended on the downside after light short-covering propped the contract to 113-28/32. Estimated volume for Sept was about 270,000 contracts, traders said. ((Chicago derivatives desk (312)408-8750))
